'''Micro Applications, Inc.''' or '''MicroApp''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] chip manufacturing corporation that was based on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], in the city of [[Tal'cara]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

Its generic chipsets were known to be used by a wide range of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and pocket computer makers. Some of their customers were criminals who operated spying, tracking, or triggering devices.<ref name="guide" /> 

By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the company was still stuggling to join the ecosystem of the big-contracted corporations.<ref name="guide" />
